create.name: Yolande van Rosmalen
create.bio:
Yolande van Rosmalen brought Quantum-Touch to the Netherlands. With her fellow kinesiologist Linda Menkhorst she founded QTouch Trainingen in 2005, the year she took her first Quantum-Touch course with the American instructor Denise Godfrey, and since 2015 the pair have acted as the method's official Dutch representatives, supporting Dutch-speaking students, practitioners and instructors around the world. She has worked as a therapist since 1987 and trained as a kinesiologist in the early nineties, and has also explored other healing approaches such as Magnified Healing and polarity work. She lives in Alkmaar, in North Holland, and is certified to teach every Quantum-Touch level from one to five, as well as to train new Level 1 instructors.

Together with Linda she teaches most of the school's courses herself, joined by a small team of further instructors. Workshops run over a weekend at a community centre in Heiloo, on the edge of Alkmaar, and can also be followed online. The programme starts with Becoming Energized, the two-day foundation in breathing, body awareness and running life-force energy, and continues through Becoming Supercharged, Becoming Heart-Conscious and Becoming Miraculous, which applies the method to manifesting a chosen future. The school also runs afternoons for children and for working with animals, and practice groups both in person and online.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 1: Becoming Energized
courses.description: The two-day foundation workshop, taught in Dutch in Heiloo and online several times a year (January, April, August and October 2027 are listed). It covers the breathing and body-awareness techniques for running life-force energy, hands-on and at a distance, for yourself, others and animals.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 2: Becoming Supercharged
courses.description: A two-day follow-on to Level 1 that adds techniques for amplifying the energy and holding the effect of a session for longer, including work with the twelve chakras and colour. Held in Heiloo and online.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 4: Becoming Heart-Conscious
courses.description: An advanced two-day workshop, formerly called QT2, built on Richard Gordon's later discoveries about working from the heart. Open to anyone who has done Level 1; in Heiloo and online.

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level 5: Becoming Miraculous
courses.description: A fourteen-hour workshop, live or online, on using life-force energy to manifest a chosen future in areas such as work, relationships and abundance, and on breaking old patterns that repeat. It can be used for yourself or in a coaching role.
